page1_s2.raw_text: Contact your agent for personalized service.

page1_s4.raw_text: The coverages, limits and policy period shown apply only if you pay for this policy to renew. Your coverage begins on April 1, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. This policy expires on April 1, 2027 at 12:01 a.m. Your insurance policy and any policy endorsements contain a full explanation of your coverage. The policy limits shown for a vehicle may not be combined with the limits for the same coverage on another vehicle. The policy contract is form 5979 NY (10/17). The contract is modified by forms Z385 NY (12/07) and A135 NY (11/13).

page1_s5.section_title: SEE ENCLOSURE FOR SUPPLEMENTAL SPOUSAL LIABILITY INSURANCE NOTICE Supplementary Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist: (SUM)
page1_s5.raw_text: The maximum amount payable under SUM coverage shall be the policy's SUM limits reduced and thus offset by motor vehicle bodily injury liability insurance policy or bond payments received from, or on behalf of, any negligent party involved in the accident, as specified in the SUM endorsement.

page2_s1.raw_text: 947850760 Q TH01498 INS DECPAGE U POLWHITEFONT TQVI3RL7WM6YEKOYL7N2PDAYJC0003 RPUID TRACWHITEFONT BDF_SL

page2_s2.raw_text: Please review the Rating Information provided in the Required Information Notice, Form 4746, included in this mailing, for a description of discounts which may be available if you qualify.

page2_s3.raw_text: This policy is not surcharged. Surcharges may be applied in the future as outlined in the Rating Information provided in the Required Information Notice, Form 4746, included in this mailing.

page2_s4.section_title: Important information about Accessories on your motorcycle/off-road vehicle
page2_s4.raw_text: Coverage for physical damage to your motorcycle/off-road vehicle extends only to the vehicle as it comes from the factory. Accessories added on at the dealership or by an individual, and therefore not provided as original equipment by the manufacturer, are not considered part of the vehicle as delivered from the factory. If you have purchased comprehensive or collision coverage, we provide up to $3000 of accessory coverage at no additional charge to you. Please review the value of the accessories on your vehicle. Should you wish to purchase coverage for more accessories, additional accessory coverage is available at very reasonable rates.

page2_s5.raw_text: This policy has been assigned to the Ultra Preferred D tier.

page3_s3.section_title: Your Motorcycle Policy is Ready for Renewal
page3_s3.raw_text: Thanks for being a Progressive customer since April 1, 2021; renew your policy today. Enclosed are your policy documents and ID cards. Your current policy period ends April 1, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. This renewal offer is for the policy period April 1, 2026 through April 1, 2027. Your 12-month policy premium excluding billing fees and payment option discounts is $125.00.

page3_s5.raw_text: OR try Automatic Payments! Installment payments without the work–we’ll process your payment for you and you could save! Get started at progressiveagent.com or call us at 1-800-876-5581. Please see your payment schedule. If you've scheduled a payment, it is not reflected in the amount due.

page3_s6.raw_text: Please allow five to seven days for processing. Write your policy number on your check. Make check payable to Progressive Northwestern Ins Co.
